GenAHCI 6.3.0.1 - source pin (USOS 1.0 audit, 2026-09-28)

Upstream repository: https://github.com/GeorgeK1ng/GenAHCI
Tag "GenAHCI" = commit b936a0d8bdf410928aefa9e0f373fb1d6c7c8240
  (2023-08-21 21:34 UTC, the last commit; the release "GenAHCI" with
  GenAHCI_6.3.0.1.7z was published 2023-08-21 21:42 UTC from this tag).
Archive: GenAHCI-b936a0d8bdf410928aefa9e0f373fb1d6c7c8240.tar.gz
  (GitHub tarball of that commit)
  SHA-256 4dda80ca7252e4b148d6137aacea7a4746ee30c63896b6aeb6f4902eeb337bde
Binary used by USOS: tools/vendor/xp-modern/2026-09-21/GenAHCI_6.3.0.1.7z
  SHA-256 f8dd54123934c176a2b6315df7b4a1dfe2ff6761fa3bc27cecfeedbe421b279f

Licence: the repository has no LICENSE file; the source tree and the
release archive both carry the same gpl.txt (GNU GPL version 3,
SHA-256 3972dc97...), used here as the licence (GPL-3.0-only). The code is
based on the Microsoft WDK 8.1 StorAhci sample (msdn-code-gallery-microsoft)
and Kai Schtrom's storahci-for-windows-2003 patch; the file headers keep
"Copyright (C) Microsoft Corporation".

Match between source and binaries (what could be checked):
- genahci.sys x86/x64: FileVersion 6.3.0.1 ("built by: WinDDK"), PE link
  times 2023-08-21 21:40:00/01 UTC: after the last source upload (21:17) and
  before the release (21:42). sources: TARGETNAME = genahci.
- gpl.txt: byte-identical in source and release.
- genahci.inf: identical content except that the release copy drops the
  5-line "Copyright Kai Schtrom 2020" header.
- txtsetup.oem: the source copy still names storahci.*; the release copy is
  the same file with storahci renamed to GenAHCI.
- genahci.sys was NOT rebuilt byte for byte: the build (make_fre.cmd) needs
  the Windows Driver Kit 7600.16385.1 (Microsoft, not redistributable, not
  installed here), and the binaries are self-signed at build time, so a
  rebuild would differ anyway in the signature.

Conclusion: commit b936a0d is the only published source and is consistent
with the 6.3.0.1 binaries, but the match is not byte-verified. Proposal:
build the USOS copy from this pinned source with WDK 7600.16385.1
(make_fre.cmd without the self-signing step) and ship that build, so the
binary provably corresponds to the offered source.
